card.name: Web page timestamps and URL endings
card.fires_on: The last piece of a timestamp (PM, EDT, CEST) or a character inside a long URL or ID string on web pages. It also fires on a few scattered words such as same, match or original.

modes.label: Timestamp endings
modes.description: AM/PM or time zone right after a clock time in a 'Last modified' line.
modes.example: Last modified: October 8, 2002 8:12:07<< PM>> Ask an Astronomer is hosted

modes.label: Inside URLs and IDs
modes.description: A digit or letter within a long web address or hex ID.

modes.label: Scattered plain words
modes.description: An ordinary word in running web text, such as same or original.
modes.example: is the<< same>> content a user will see

card.plain: It marks the end of a date-and-time stamp or the middle of a long web address in page footers.
